name: @jadwigo/lesson-kit
description: The lesson stage, its parts and the interaction families that draw a question

//.@dnd-kit/core: dragging in the drag parts (src/parts/SortableList.tsx and the Group and Sequence views)
//.@dnd-kit/utilities: the CSS transform a dragged item takes (src/parts/SortableList.tsx)
//.@jadwigo/contracts: the family data, key, value, help and verdict types every view is typed with
//.@jadwigo/copy: every line a child reads in a part or a view, in pl and en
//.@jadwigo/ui: Zeszyt's primitives and cn() the parts are built from
//.@shadcn/react: the unstyled Questionnaire under StepFrame and ChoiceList: one radio group, arrow keys and A-E shortcuts. Its peer is React 19; it runs on React 18 because it calls only React 18 hooks
//.@testing-library/react: renders a part or a family view in a *.test.tsx and queries it the way a person would
//.@types/node: Node 24 types for this package's typecheck (tsconfig.base.json names them)
//.@types/react-dom: types for react-dom in the component tests
//.happy-dom: the DOM the dom Vitest project runs *.test.tsx in
//.katex: draws the TeX in question text (src/parts/RichText.tsx)
//.react: the stage, parts and family views in src/**/*.tsx
//.react-dom: React's renderer, which @testing-library/react renders the components with
//.typescript: tsc for this package's typecheck script
//.vitest: runs this package's unit test with the root vitest.config.ts
